The Opportunity
We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer with a front-end focus to build the user experience of Agentic Governance services within Adobe's Experience Platform team in Bucharest.
Trust and Governance builds the services that enable our enterprise customers to trust us with their data: access control, data usage policies and lineage enforcement, catalog, privacy and consent, audit and security capabilities such as customer-managed keys. Agentic Governance extends these foundations to AI agents: who an agent is, what it may do, and a verifiable record of what it did.
You will own the governance admin experience: the console where customers and Adobe teams see which agents exist. Enterprises are putting AI agents to work on their data, and regulation such as the EU AI Act is setting a higher standard for governing them. How should people see and control what an agent may do? This is a new product surface, designed and built from Bucharest.
What You'll Do
Own the architecture of the Agentic Governance UI: state management, performance, accessibility and component design. 
Make complex governance concepts such as permissions, policies and audit trails clear and usable for administrators. 
Build AI-powered experiences in the UI, such as natural-language policy authoring or audit explanations, with the right guardrails. 
Build features and own the quality of what you ship: testing, monitoring and performance. 
Use AI-assisted development responsibly, and help the team raise its front-end practice. 
Partner with product, design and back-end engineers, and mentor peers on front-end architecture. 
 What You Need to Succeed
5+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
Deep front-end expertise in React and TypeScript, including ownership of state, performance and architecture in a production application, not only use of a component library. 
Full-stack delivery: designing and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs and working with PostgreSQL. 
Experience shipping through CI/CD and deploying to AWS or Azure. 
Strong testing habits for UI and APIs. 
 Preferred Qualifications
Built LLM-powered UI features such as streaming responses, copilot patterns or human-in-the-loop review. 
Back-end experience in a modern language (Python preferred)
Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. 
Accessibility standards (WCAG).
